Question: Who are our top sellers?
text:
```sql
SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_sales
FROM order_items AS oi
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
This query adds up the price and freight for each seller’s items, then lists the sellers with the highest total sales.
